setup: The size of a product is predicted without computing it.

steps.say: The first factor is [[a]]/[[b]] and the second is [[c]]/[[d]].
A factor greater than 1 makes the product larger than the other factor and a factor less than 1 makes it smaller.
The product can also be compared with 1 by comparing the product of the numerators with the product of the denominators.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
